Chapter 515: Chapter 13 Comprehending The Complete Space Rules (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 515: Chapter 13 Comprehending the Complete Space Rules (Subscription Requested)

The reason Molang Scholar only sent invitation letters to scholars of the Evolver level,

is that the essence of space and time he speaks of is very difficult for founders below the level of a scholar to comprehend.

Even listening for a while longer can create cognitive barriers and affect their own understanding of space and time.

Without reaching a certain height, forcibly knowing information of that height often has the opposite effect.

Great Scholar Tai’e planned to give the invitation to Lin Yuan because through their interactions over time,

he confirmed that Lin Yuan’s aptitude and comprehension were extremely formidable. It would be more beneficial than harmful if he could have the opportunity to listen to Molang Scholar’s lecture.

...

That was the reason for their conversation just now.

Anyhow, Great Scholar Tai’e himself wasn’t particularly interested in Molang Scholar’s lecture since he had heard it many times before, and missing it once was no big deal.

But Lin Yuan was different.

In Great Scholar Tai’e’s eyes, Lin Yuan was a newcomer, his junior, who had never been in touch with Molang Scholar before.

As a founding scholar and predecessor within human civilization, Great Scholar Tai’e felt it was his duty to look after Lin Yuan.

However.

When Great Scholar Tai’e saw that Lin Yuan had an invitation identical to his own, he became somewhat stupefied.

An invitation meant only for Evolver scholars appeared in Lin Yuan’s hands?

What was going on?

Great Scholar Tai’e’s thoughts whirled, and he immediately thought of the only possibility.

That was that Lin Yuan was also an Evolver scholar.

That was why he had said, “When did you become a scholar too?”

After all, in Great Scholar Tai’e’s eyes, Lin Yuan had definitely not been an Evolver scholar before.

Otherwise, the Goddess of Wisdom would not have prevented him from retrieving Lin Yuan’s information so adamantly.

…

After giving some perfunctory responses to Great Scholar Tai’e for a while,

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World.

Lin Yuan felt indifferent about Great Scholar Tai’e discovering his true identity.

Every Evolver scholar of human civilization is absolutely trustworthy. Just pioneering a stable Evolution Path at the Eighth Layer is merely a prerequisite to becoming an Evolver scholar.

“Molang Scholar…” Lin Yuan looked at the golden invitation letter once more.

He hadn’t taken it seriously when he first received it because Lin Yuan was still too young. Having not experienced many things, he was unaware of what Molang Scholar’s lectures meant, and the three Goddesses would not always remind him.

Furthermore, the invitation letter did not mention anything about the Rule of Time or Complete Space Rules.

If it weren’t coming from Molang Scholar, Lin Yuan might not even have given it a second glance.

“I might as well listen when the time comes,”

Lin Yuan thought, deciding it would not be a waste of time. As Evolver scholars of human civilization focusing on specific research domains, if Supreme Beings represent the height of human civilization, then scholars represent its depth.

…

“Hmm? The Goddess of Freedom has already communicated, and now the invincible Evolvers of the Eighth Layer on Battlefield B0001 would like to meet with me and discuss in detail?”

Upon receiving the message from the Goddess of Freedom, Lin Yuan immediately agreed.

The so-called discussion was naturally to take place in the Virtual World, its content would be about confirming Lin Yuan’s approach; when to take action, and which of the Tianyu Clan’s powerhouses to deal with, among other things.

All these needed to be determined through prior communication.

As the invited party, Lin Yuan received a substantial amount of Merit Points as remuneration and naturally had to actively cooperate.

…

In a Virtual World,

stood a majestic, grand palace.

The short, stout elder and a group of invincible beings from Battlefield B0001 who were at the Eighth Layer had long been waiting there.

“Galactic Star Master should be coming soon,”

“Not sure if the Galactic Star Master is easy to talk to,”

“I actually have some ties with Chikun Starlord, the teacher of Galactic Star Master. Chikun Starlord is forthright, so I expect the Galactic Star Master to be straightforward,”

the many invincibles within the palace murmured to each other in low voices.

Galactic Star Master was indeed very powerful, capable of killing two invincibles of the Eighth Layer, but the enemies they were about to face were many strong members of the Tianyu Clan, a Peak Clan.

If one or two invincibles at the Eighth Layer couldn’t match Galactic Star Master, what about ten or eight of them? Galactic Star Master would definitely have to pay a price to hold them off.

If Galactic Star Master was unwilling to pay that price and didn’t work hard enough, then it would be their headache.

After all, they couldn’t dare to demand that Galactic Star Master must hold back the many strong beings of the Tianyu Clan—that request would be too much. Who knew how many invincibles at the Eighth Layer the Tianyu Clan could mobilize?

As one of the Peak Clans, the Tianyu Clan certainly had the capability to bring hundreds of invincible Eighth Layer powerhouses over.

And each invincible powerhouse at the Eighth Layer working together with various Secret Treasures could unleash terrifying power.

Suddenly—

A figure appeared out of nowhere in the palace, his gaze serene, looking at the many invincible Evolvers with a smile and saying, “Hello everyone, I am the Galactic Star Master.”

“Galactic Star Master,”

“Greetings, Galactic Star Master,”

“Over here, Galactic Star Master,”

One after another, the invincibles at the Eighth Layer immediately showed their enthusiasm; after all, they were relying on Lin Yuan in the upcoming war, so naturally, they couldn’t be indifferent now.

“Galactic Star Master,”

the short, stout elder spoke with a solemn expression, looking sincerely at Lin Yuan.

“Baiyun Lord,” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

This short, stout elder, named Baiyun, was the Star Lord of the Baiyun Star Domain. The Cosmic Force he had mastered might not be a high-level Cosmic Force, but among ordinary Cosmic Forces, it was quite powerful.

Many invincible beings at the Eighth Layer in the B0001 Exotic Battlefield generally regarded Baiyun Lord as their leader.
